fields.proposed_named_inputs: Refined Lead + Sulfuric Acid (electrolyte); suitable case, connectors and separators TBD
fields.proposed_finished_unit: one finished stationary lead-acid battery module (capacity and mass TBD)
fields.open_decision: Approved distinct chemistry and named physical product. Stationary industrial/backup use; exact internal plates, formation process, housing, safety, rating, yield, manufacturing equipment, price and final ingredient quantities TBD.

fields.proposed_named_inputs: Lithium Carbonate (upstream cathode precursor only) + Refined Graphite (potential anode) + Refined Copper (current collector) + compatible cathode chemistry/electrolyte/separator TBD
fields.proposed_finished_unit: one finished lithium-based rechargeable battery module (capacity and mass TBD)
fields.open_decision: Approved distinct lithium-based battery product for mobile/weight-sensitive equipment. No specific lithium-ion cathode chemistry, lithium carbonate direct-use cathode conversion, material ratios, process, thermal/safety electronics, cost, rating, price or consumer mapping approved.

fields.proposed_named_inputs: Stainless Steel + Refined Ceramic + appropriate thermal insulation (exact approved insulating stock and specialised variants TBD)
fields.proposed_finished_unit: one finished Thermal Part or service module (size and mass TBD)
fields.open_decision: Heat exchangers, thermal barriers and equipment thermal management. Insulation selection, precise quantities, rating, manufacture, consumer Machine links and price TBD; Optical Parts separate.

fields.proposed_named_inputs: Glass + Refined Ceramic + suitable structural metal; Optical Sapphire optional for specialist precision optics only
fields.proposed_finished_unit: one finished optical component or service module (size and mass TBD)
fields.open_decision: Lenses, mirrors, concentrators and optical instruments. Refined metal identity and specialist optical material suitability depend on application; exact quantities, optical grade, tooling, compatibility and price TBD.

fields.proposed_finished_unit: one finished forming/cutting tool or standard service tooling kit (size/rating TBD)
fields.open_decision: Approved for forming dies, cutting inserts and industrial machine tooling. Do not require Refined Copper solely because the old combined Fabrication Parts recipe had it. Exact tooling form/grade, material quantities, process, lifetime, mass and price remain TBD.

fields.proposed_named_inputs: Refined Copper + Steel + suitable heat-resistant insulation (specified qualified stock TBD; Mica Insulation Sheets or Refined Ceramic to be evaluated)
fields.proposed_finished_unit: one finished welding head/contact/consumable service kit (type/rating TBD)
fields.open_decision: Approved for suitable welding heads, contacts and joining equipment. Heat-resistant insulation is approved as a family only, not exact grade, composition or quantity. Machine compatibility, wear, welding mode, tooling and price TBD.

fields.proposed_named_inputs: Cement + Graded Aggregate + suitable sand + process water + Steel if reinforced
fields.proposed_finished_unit: one finished cured transportable section (size TBD)
fields.open_decision: Material families approved; optional reinforcement where structural requirements justify. Exact section size, strength, steel compatibility, recipe ratios, equipment, curing time and price remain TBD.

fields.proposed_named_inputs: Uranium Concentrate (approved upstream source) + qualified fabricated fuel form + protective cladding + structural components; exact materials/grades and all manufacturing steps TBD
fields.proposed_finished_unit: one finished compatible fission-reactor consumable assembly (rating and service life TBD)
fields.open_decision: Approved one independently stockable finished fission fuel assembly with specialist qualified production and installed depletion, yielding tracked Spent Nuclear Fuel. No additional saleable processing intermediates by default. Specific fuel chemistry, cladding, quantities, facility/machine compatibility, waste rules, pricing and reactor design TBD; distinct from Fusion Fuel and existing fusion Ship Reactor.
